title: Babel Finance begins operating
description: Babel Finance developed as a Hong Kong-based crypto lender serving institutional and high-net-worth clients.

title: Babel Finance suspends withdrawals
description: Babel Finance suspended redemptions and withdrawals during the 2022 crypto credit crisis, citing unusual liquidity pressures.

title: Babel restructuring path begins
description: After the halt, Babel Finance moved into negotiations and restructuring efforts rather than normal platform operations.
notes: Current outcome should be revisited with direct restructuring sources.

title: Nexo begins operating
description: Nexo developed as a crypto lending and interest-account platform offering borrowing and yield-like products.

title: Nexo settles U.S. Earn Interest Product charges
description: Nexo agreed to settle U.S. securities-regulator charges related to its Earn Interest Product and to cease offering the product to U.S. investors.
notes: Regulatory event, not a platform-failure event.

title: U.S. return through partner structure reported
description: Nexo was reported to be returning to the U.S. market through a partner structure after earlier regulatory restrictions.
notes: Jurisdictional availability should be monitored over time.

title: Ledn begins operating
description: Ledn developed as a bitcoin-backed lending and savings-oriented crypto platform.

title: Proof or reserve-style transparency maintained
description: Ledn continued to publish reserve or transparency-oriented materials as part of its active lender positioning.
notes: Use as active comparator evidence, not a failure event.

title: BlockFills begins operating
description: BlockFills developed as an institutional digital asset trading, liquidity, and financing platform.

title: BlockFills client deposits and withdrawals reportedly halted
description: BlockFills reportedly paused client deposits and withdrawals during a market downturn while maintaining some trading activity.
